title: Two days ago I shared my free browser roguelite here. Since then I added a Necromancer, a Daily Challenge and a full visual overhaul
author: Background_Ranger667
selftext:
Two days ago I posted Hollowdelve here, a small survivors-like roguelite you can play for free in your browser, on phone or PC. Thanks to everyone who tried it and left feedback! I’ve been busy since then, so here’s what’s new:

New hero: the Necromancer  
Enemies she defeats can rise again as skeletons that fight for her. The bigger your army, the faster rooms clear, and the more skeletons you get.

Daily Challenge  
One run per day, the same for everyone: fixed hero, fixed worlds, one curse and one blessing. You can copy your score and compare it with others.

31 achievements that actually matter  
Each one has its own icon, and most give you a small permanent bonus for all future runs.

Visual overhaul

* Every world has its own wall colours now instead of grey stone with a colour filter on top
* Real chasms instead of black squares, water with shores, new spike traps
* Torches are placed on purpose instead of randomly
* New title screen, cleaner HUD and tidier upgrade cards

What it is, in short:

* 8 heroes, 7 acts, 17 bosses, 32 weapons with evolutions
* Auto-saves after every room
* Completely free, no ads, no sign-up

Full transparency: the code was written with the help of an AI (Claude). All art, music and sound comes from free asset packs made by human artists, credited in the game.

I’d love to hear what you think. Which hero feels the strongest, and where do you usually die?

Link: [https://binjack.itch.io/hollowdelve](https://binjack.itch.io/hollowdelve)
